inspection.state_comparison_rule: Exact tensor dtype/shape/value-byte equality and scalar float-byte equality, including matched diagnostic NaN markers; no NaN accepted in recorded scientific metrics.
inspection.verification: Artifact identities, recorded protocol/verdicts, saved arrays and checkpoint-bound action state. Root separately recertified all twelve original receipts at frozen source.

limits: Bitwise equality covers retained target/sample arrays and learned endpoints, not every intermediate optimizer update or complete policy equivalence.
Both original smoke gates pass for LR.0053125/prior1.5; added broad hold has only two later checks, so no deeper gate was admitted.
The six deeper cases remain UNKNOWN for every candidate; native Atlas feature-cell quality was never tested here.
All twelve fresh-run monotone surprise.fires counters are zero; no accepted optimizer reopening acted. Guard epoch rebases are separate loss-reference bookkeeping.
Exact cause of transient template loss and late projected-law acquisition is unresolved; no per-owner pre/post-failure checkpoint snapshots or component gradients were retained.
The finite screening grid is terminal. No further parameter strengths, repeats, budget extensions or default adoption are proposed.
